pairwise_loss.interpretation: Exact loss identity, not an accuracy guarantee. Pair constraints are correlated.
limitations: Equal total workload weight does not mean equal host-vs-fused pair weight.
Average squared log-ratio error is not decision regret or worst-case loss.
The same ridge number does not imply equal regularization across feature designs.
